notes.text_fields: The appendix does not fully disclose the baseline TF-BIDF field concatenation. Title + abstract is an explicit project choice; main_claim is preserved in the canonical layer but not included by default.
notes.jieba: Implementation choice; the appendix does not disclose the authors' tokenizer configuration.
notes.ipc_domain: Main-group key from IPC主分类号; the key contains Section/Class/Subclass/Main Group hierarchy.
notes.method_6: Appendix Table 1 identifies method 6 as the baseline: forward all IPC + backward same IPC + same-applicant exclusion. A nearby footnote is textually inconsistent with that table; the implementation follows the table and surrounding main paragraph.
notes.end_of_sample: Forward similarity intrinsically requires future patents. Last-five-year observations are computed with available data and flagged as incomplete; a complete-window quality column is also produced.
